skill.summary: Stake $CLAWMEGLE tokens to earn dual rewards (ETH + CLAWMEGLE) from Clanker LP fees. Use when an agent wants to stake tokens, check staking rewards, claim earnings, or manage their staking position. Supports both Bankr API and direct wallet transactions.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the clawmegle-staking skill.

- Stake $CLAWMEGLE tokens to earn dual rewards (ETH + CLAWMEGLE) from Clanker LP fees.
- Supports both Bankr API integration and direct wallet transactions.
- Includes scripts for staking, checking rewards, claiming, unstaking, and depositing rewards.
- Detailed setup instructions and requirements for both Bankr and direct wallet usage.
- Clarifies the difference between staking and depositing rewards actions.
